archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / CYBERPUNK DEGEN META-TECH

brand_identity.logo_mark: Glowing mint-green FeeCat profile mark + F-leaf neon badge
taglines: Same transactions. Zero fees. More for you.
brand_identity.feecat_lore: FeeCat is the autonomous zero-fee router mascot inspecting contracts, routing liquidity, and burning fees.
brand_identity.feeback_vision: Fee-Back Vision redirects network priority rebates directly back into trader wallets and $FEE token liquidity pools.

globe_hero.concept: Full-Screen 3D Globe Hero for Ecosystem Social Discovery
globe_hero.interaction: User clicks any ecosystem node (Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Sui, Monad, etc.). Screen blurs immediately via CSS backdrop-filter (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 z-40) revealing a social-first immersive chain view.

left_rail.content: Live Ecosystem Chat with auto contract-address recognition (CA badge -> Token Card modal trigger), degen emojis, user badges, live message stream, and send bar.

overlay_structure.background: 3D Globe running softly in the background with dynamic blur filter and reduced opacity.

right_content_area.flex: flex-1 p-6 flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-y-auto

sections.name: Live Activity Pulse & Who's Online
sections.component: High-density horizontal status ribbon showing online degens, active chatters, live tx/sec, and recent fee-back rebates.

sections.name: New Stuff Feed (Fresh & Trending Launches)
sections.component: Real-time feed of newly created coins & trending launches on that ecosystem with token image, symbol, market cap, 5m/1h gain, creator badge, copy CA button, and quick buy trigger. NO liquidity tables or pools here.

sections.name: Minimal Tucked Quick-Links
sections.component: Discreet floating dock at the bottom-right with icon-only or pill links to Ecosystem Launchpad, DEX, Explorer, and Bridge.

degen_terminal.concept: Advanced DeGen Command Terminal - Live Operating System for On-Chain Markets
degen_terminal.header_ticker: Top high-density scrolling ticker bar (data-testid='terminal-ticker') featuring $FEE, $SOL, trending degen tokens, gas/priority fees, and FeeCat status.
degen_terminal.main_workspace: Dynamic tab switching container with tab-specific high-density grid layouts, zero-latency inputs, live candlestick charts, and interactive tokenomics.
degen_terminal.right_rail: Alpha Tape live intelligence stream + Quick In-App Jupiter Swap Panel + FeeCat assistant status.

tab_design_blueprints.Discover: Ecosystem intelligence radar: Trending tokens, volume spikes, smart money wallets tracker, and sentiment indicators.
tab_design_blueprints.Launch: FeeCat Zero-Fee Token Launchpad step-by-step wizard: Token metadata input, fair launch bonding curve settings, team allocation locks, and instant mint tool.
tab_design_blueprints.Portfolio: Live wallet PnL command center: Token balances, unrealized gains, transaction history, fee-back earnings, and asset pie chart.
tab_design_blueprints.Fee-Back: Fee-Back Vision educational & reward hub: Live breakdown of trading rebate payouts, claimable $FEE rewards, cashback calculator for high volume degens.
tab_design_blueprints.FEE_Token: $FEE Ecosystem Token Center: Live price, circulating supply, buy/burn stats, interactive tokenomics pie/bar breakdown, and staking pool status.
tab_design_blueprints.FeeCat: FeeCat AI Command Center & Lore Hub: Interactive FeeCat mascot status, automated arbitrage bot logs, fee burn stats, and community proposals.
tab_design_blueprints.Chat: Global Degen Chatroom: Multi-channel chat, CA contract address auto-parser, tip jar, user rank badges, and token callouts.
tab_design_blueprints.Leaderboard: Top Degens Hall of Fame: Daily/weekly PnL leaderboard, top fee-back earners, copy-trading wallet highlights.

tab_design_blueprints.Learn: Degen Onboarding & Newbie Hub: Clear visual explanation of Fee-Back, how zero-fee trading works, Solana wallet setup, and token safety guide.
tab_design_blueprints.Roadmap: Interactive Ecosystem Roadmap: Timeline phases (Phase 1: Terminal, Phase 2: Fee-Back Engine, Phase 3: Multi-chain Globe, Phase 4: Autonomous FeeCat Agent) with completion badges.

testing_and_accessibility.rule: All interactive buttons, tabs, inputs, chat components, cards, and modal triggers MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark mint-neon theme (#14F195 / #00FFA3) with dark charcoal background (#060709).

Ensure when an ecosystem node on the 3D globe is clicked, the whole page transitions into an immersive Ecosystem Overlay: LEFT side has the live community chat, BACKGROUND has the blurred globe, RIGHT side has the 'New Stuff' feed of trending/fresh tokens and live activity pulse, with minimal tucked-away quick links.
STRICTLY NO pools or liquidity tables on the Ecosystem social overlay page.
Ensure ALL 16 terminal sidebar tabs are fully styled, populated with realistic data/interactive components, and look extremely advanced.
Make sure new users can clearly understand the concept of $FEE, FeeCat, and Fee-Back Vision via visual onboarding cards and educational widgets.
